purpose: Teach: 羽根/遊戯/製図/海面/浴室/祖父母/出稼ぎ/蔵書

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お正月にお父さんと羽根つきしましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's play badminton with Dad over New Year's, shall we?
lines.style: Warm, inviting, gentle. Open vowels on the request. A slight lift at the end — not a question, but inclusive. Tender attention focused on him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんが昔遊戯ボードを作ってくれたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad made me a game board a long time ago.
lines.style: Quiet pride. Careful enunciation on the past tense — he's remembering something he treasures. Soft but steady. The voice of someone sharing something meaningful.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが製図道具を整理してらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, I noticed your father was organizing his drafting tools earlier.
lines.style: Gentle observation. Measured pace. A hint of fondness — she's noticing something about him. Trailing thought at the end, like she's connecting small details.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、海面が夕日できれいだったよ
lines.en: Mom, the ocean looked so pretty at sunset today.
lines.style: Bright, immediate, eager to share. Quick pace. The voice of a child who saw something beautiful and needs to tell someone about it right now.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、新しい浴室、気持ちいいわね
lines.en: Sho, the new bathroom is so nice and comfortable, isn't it?
lines.style: Contented warmth. Appreciative, noticing small comforts. Conversational, almost to herself — sharing a moment of domestic pleasure with him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、祖父母にあう日が楽しみだよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm looking forward to the day we visit Grandma and Grandpa.
lines.style: Earnest excitement, well-mannered. Steady buildup on 'looking forward' — genuine anticipation without being loud. The quiet joy of a thoughtful child.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが若い頃、出稼ぎで頑張られたんですって
lines.en: Sho, when your father was young, he worked hard as a migrant laborer, you know.
lines.style: Reflective, respectful. Slight pause before the detail — she's choosing her words carefully. Tone carries quiet admiration for his past effort. Contemplative.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんの蔵書、読んでみたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I'd like to read some of Dad's books.
lines.style: Softly determined. Attentive to the weight of what he's asking — wanting to know his father through his books. Gentle but clear. The close of a vulnerable wish.
